title: Detection and Positive Reconstruction of Cognitive Distortion sentences: Mandarin Dataset and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating a dataset of Mandarin psychology Q&A sentences for the presence of cognitive distortions (negative, rigid, and inaccurate thought patterns) and training classification models like RoBERTa to detect them.

Evaluating the semantic similarity (using ROUGE, BLEU, and BERTScore) of LLM-generated positive reconstructions against ground truth references for five different psychological strategies to observe if models inherently lean toward a specific reframing strategy (e.g., an optimistic bias).
